title: Full z.ai Anthropic API Support in Pipecat (Runtime Switching)
description: Implement proper z.ai Anthropic API delegation with frame relay, sticky-turn gate, and comprehensive testing. Fix the architectural gap where AnthropicLLMService is initialized but never reached by frames.

stories.title: Refactor SwitchableLLMService to inherit LLMService with separate delegates
stories.description: Change SwitchableLLMService from inheriting OpenAILLMService to inheriting LLMService base. Construct OpenAILLMService and AnthropicLLMService as separate member instances. Validate at least one provider key exists.
acceptanceCriteria: src/switchable_llm.py line 18 changed to: class SwitchableLLMService(LLMService):
self._or_service is a separate OpenAILLMService instance (not self)
self._zai_service is AnthropicLLMService instance with AsyncAnthropic client
Frame relay installed on both delegates via _install_frame_relay()
z.ai boot smoke test validates API key shape (startswith 'sk-')
Initialization raises if both keys missing, logs INFO if only one provider available
Unit tests U1, U2, U3 pass (delegate construction, key validation)

stories.title: Implement delegating surface with frame relay and sticky-turn gate
stories.description: Add _install_frame_relay(), _active_delegate(), process_frame() with sticky-turn gate, lifecycle methods (setup, start, stop, cancel, cleanup), and function registration fan-out. Implement _is_provider_error() and _handle_provider_failure() for error recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: _install_frame_relay() patches delegate.push_frame and broadcast_frame to relay through wrapper
_active_delegate() returns currently active delegate without calling _sync_provider()
process_frame() triggers _sync_provider() only on (OpenAILLMContextFrame, LLMContextFrame, LLMMessagesFrame)
process_frame() locks _turn_delegate and sets _turn_in_flight on turn-start frames
Sticky-turn gate unlocks (_turn_in_flight=False, _turn_delegate=None) on relayed LLMFullResponseEndFrame
setup() propagates FrameProcessorSetup to both delegates and saves for lazy start
start() calls await active.start(frame), not queue_frame()
_ensure_delegate_started() calls await delegate.start() for lazy-started inactive delegate
stop(), cancel(), cleanup() fan-out to both delegates
register_function() and unregister_function() fan-out to both delegates
_is_provider_error() detects AuthenticationError, APIStatusError, APIConnectionError, httpx exceptions
_handle_provider_failure() rate-limits logs to once per 60s, sets _zai_disabled=True, clears gate, retries on OpenRouter
Unit tests U4-U9 pass (frame relay, turn-gate, lifecycle, registration, error handling)
Integration tests I1-I3 pass (tools visibility, provider switching, schema compatibility)

stories.title: Sanity check pipeline integration and update observability
stories.description: Verify pipeline.py constructor call still works unchanged. Add provider tag to boot logs and metrics. Surface active_provider in watch dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: src/pipeline.py lines 394-401 (LLM service construction) work without changes

make build succeeds; boot logs include provider=openrouter by default

MetricsData tagged with provider before each turn delegation
active_provider property callable from watch dashboard with no per-tick file I/O
Observability tests O1-O4 pass (provider switch logging, active_provider property, metrics tagging, error indication)

stories.title: Comprehensive test suite and documentation
stories.description: Write unit tests (U1-U9), integration tests (I1-I3), e2e tests (E1-E3), and observability tests (O1-O4). Update class docstring. Verify linting and all tests pass.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/test_switchable_llm.py exists with U1-U9 test cases
tests/test_llm_tools.py extended with I1-I3 test cases
tests/integration/test_zai_e2e.py exists with E1-E3 test cases (gated by ZAI_API_KEY)
tests/test_switchable_llm_observability.py exists with O1-O4 test cases
U9 specifically asserts downstream frame visibility via FrameSpy
U7 asserts _turn_in_flight cleared after auth error
make test passes with all test suites green
make lint (ruff) returns 0 errors on src/switchable_llm.py and new test files
heare.env.example includes ZAI_API_KEY placeholder
src/switchable_llm.py docstring updated: removes apologetic 'z.ai configured but unused' text, adds operational explanation

stories.title: Manual QA and verification
stories.description: Test provider switching end-to-end in watch mode: default openrouter, switch to z.ai, toggle back. Verify tool calls work on both providers. Run architect verification and commit.
acceptanceCriteria: make build && make watch succeeds with default openrouter provider
Speak a short utterance on openrouter; verify response captured and audio flows
heare provider zai (or dashboard p key) switches to z.ai
Speak a short utterance on z.ai; verify Anthropic-shaped request visible in logs
Toggle back to openrouter; verify next turn uses OpenRouter
Trigger a tool call (e.g., 'list downloads') on openrouter; verify bash handler runs and result summarized
Trigger a tool call on z.ai; verify bash handler runs and result summarized
Architect reviewer approves implementation against acceptance criteria from prd.json
All post-deslop regression tests pass

metadata.taskDescription: Implement full z.ai Anthropic API support for pipecat with runtime provider switching. Fix the current limitation where AnthropicLLMService is created but not properly delegated.
